comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Chrono-Recipe (17th Century, phases 2-3) in Helder via Resident. Recipe is Sewing R10, and calls for:

Cotton fabric x10
Pearl x2
Fine dye x2

Stats:

+1 Dye trading
3k fame to equip, unisex

Could also be upgraded into an EX item through expensive Alchemy to have an EX effect of 17th Century, if one was so inclined and wealthy enough to pursue it.
